English: Healthy behaviors remain important for staying safe during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
Luganda: Enneeyisa mu byobulamu kisigala nga kikulu okusobola obutafuna buzibu mu kiseera ky’obulwadde bwa kovidi 2019 (COVID-19).
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwà ìmáralè ṣì ṣe pàtàkì sí dídáàbò bo ara ẹni lásìkò àrùn kòrónà ọdún 2019, àjàkálẹ̀ (COVID-19).
Zulu: Ukuziphatha kahle ngokwezempilo kubalulekile ukuze uphephe ngesikhathi sempathambhlaba ukhuvethe 2019 (COVID-19).
Hausa: Halin lafiya ya kasance yana da mahimmanci don kiyaye lafiya yayin cutar sankara na 2019 (COVID-19).
Northern Sotho: Maitshwaro a mabotse a bohlokwa ka mehla gore o dule o bolokegile nakong ya leuba la bolwetši ba coronavirus bja 2019 (COVID-19).
Amharic: በኮሮና ቫይረስ በሽታ 2019 (ኮቪድ-19) ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ ደህንነትን ለማስጠበቅ ጤናማ ባህሪያት አስፈላጊ ሆነው ይቀጥላሉ፡፡

English: This study, therefore, explored the healthy behaviors of Nigerians during the COVID-19 pandemic and the impact of COVID-19 related news on healthy behaviors.
Luganda: Noolwekyo okunonyereza kuno kwekaliriza enneeyisa mu byobulamu ez’Abanayijeeriya mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa COVID-19 n’ebyo amawulire agakwata ku COVID-19 bye gaatuusa ku nneeyisa mu byobulamu.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, ìwádìí yìí wo àwọn ìwà ìmárale àwọn ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Nàìjíríà lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19 àti ipa tí àwọn ìròyìn tí ó jẹmọ́ COVID-19 kó lórí àwọn ìwà ìmárale.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luphenye ukuziphatha kahle ngokwezempilo kwabaseNayjeriya ngesikhathi sempathamhlaba i-COVID-19 nomthelela wezindaba ezibika nge-COVID-19 ekuziphatheni kahle ngokwezempilo.
Hausa: Don haka, wannan binciken, ya binciki kyawawan halayen ƴan Najeriya yayin bala'in COVID-19 da tasirin labarai masu alaƙa da COVID-19 akan halaye masu kyau.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše, ka gona, di lekodišišitše maitshwaro a mabotse go badudi ba Nigeria nakong ya leuba la COVID-19 le khuetšo ya ditaba tše di amanago le COVID-19 go maitshwaro a mabotse.
Amharic: ስለዚህ ይህ ጥናት በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ የናይጄሪያውያኖችን ጤናማ ባህሪዎች እና ከኮቪድ-19 ጋር የተያያዙ ጤናማ ባህሪያት ላይ የተዘገቡ ዜናዎችን ዳስሷል፡፡

English: Thirty-three (17 females and 16 males) participants from the general Nigerian population with age range of 23-64 years were recruited via social media using the snowball technique.
Luganda: Abeetabi asatu mu basatu (abakazi 17 n’abasajja 16) okuva mu Banayijeeriya ab’emyaka 23-64 baafunibwa okuyita ku mikutu emigattabantu nga bakozesa akakodyo ka snowball.
Yoruba: Àwọn akópa mẹ́tàlélọ́gbọ̀n (abo 17 àti akọ 16) nínú iye òǹkà ará-ìlú Nàìjíríà tí ọjọ́-orí wọn kò wà láàrin 23-64 ni wọ́n gbà láti orí ẹ̀rọ-alátagbà ní ìlànà ìtọ́kasí.
Zulu: Abangamashumi amathathu nantathu (17 wabesifazane no 16 wabesilisa) babahlanganyeli baseNayjeriya abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka 23-64 bakhethwe ngezinkundla zokuxhumana.
Hausa: Mahalarta talatin da uku (mata 17 da maza 16) daga al’ummar Nijeriya gabaɗaya masu shekaru 23-64 an ɗauke su ta kafafen sadarwar zamani ta hanyar amfani da fasahar ƙwallon dusar ƙanƙara.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba masometharotharo (basadi ba 17 le banna ba 16) go tšwa setšhabeng sa Nigeria ka kakaretšo ba mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 23-64 ba laleditšwe ka dikgokagano tša leago go šomišwa mokgwa wa senoopolo.
Amharic: ሰላሳ-ሶስት ( 17 ሴት እና 16 ወንድ) ተሳታፊዎች ከ 23-64 ባለው የእድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ያሉ ሰዎች  ከመላው የናይጄሪያ ህብረተሰብ፣ ስኖው ቦል የተባለ ቴክኒክን በመጠቀም ከማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ተመልምለዋል፡፡

English: Responses were elicited using semi-structured questions and subjected to thematic analysis.
Luganda: Ebyokwanukula byafunibwa nga bakozesa ebibuuzo oluvannyuma ne byekenneenyerezebwa mu miramwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo àtòjọ ìbéèrè láti gba ìdáhùn lẹ́nu wọn, wọ́n sì ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ kókó-ọ̀rọ̀.
Zulu: Izimpendulo zikhethwe ngemibuzo ehleliwe yase ihlaziywa ngezihloko.
Hausa: An ba da amsa ta hanyar amfani da wasu ƙayyadaddun tambayoyi kuma an yi nazarin jigogi.
Northern Sotho: Go kgobokeditšwe dikarabo go šomišwa dipotšišo tše di beakantšwego gannyane gomme tša sekasekwa go lebeletšwe dihlogonyakišišo.
Amharic: ምላሾቹ የተቀነጠቡትበከፊል በተዋቀሩ ጥያቄዎች ሲሆን ይዞታዊ ትንተና ተደርጎባቸዋል፡፡

English: The healthy behaviors identified included; “social distancing”, “changes in nutrition”, “hand washing or sanitizing”, “exercise”, “increased vigilance from those with comorbidities”, and “use of facemask”.
Luganda: Enneeyisa mu byobulamu ezaasuulwa mwalimu; “okwewa amabanga”, “okukyusa mu ndya”, “okunaaba engalo oba okukozesa sanitizer”, “dduyiro”, “okufaayo ak’ensusso eri abo abalina obulwadde obulala”, ne “okukozesa obukookolo”.
Yoruba: Lára àwọn ìwà ìmáralé tí wọ́n tọ́ka sí ni ''ìtakété-síraẹni'', ''àyíapdà nínú potéènì jíjẹ'', ọwọ́ fífọ̀ àti ìmọ́tótó'', ''ìdárayá'', '' ṣísọra lọ́dọ̀ àwọn onígba-àrùn'', àti ''lílo ìbòmú''.
Zulu: Ukuziphatha kahle ngokwezempilo okubonakele kubalwe kukho “ukuqhelelana”, “ukushintsha indlela yokudla”, “ukugezwa kwezandla noma ukusebenzisa isibulala magciwane”, “ukuzivocavoca”, “ukuziqapha kwalabo abanezifo eziphathana kanyekanye”.“nokusetshenziswa kwesamfonyo”.
Hausa: Hanyoyin da aka gano lafiya sun haɗa da; "Sanya nisantar jama'a", "canje-canje a cikin abinci mai gina jiki", "wanke hannu ko tsabtace hannu", " motsa jiki", "ƙarin yin taka tsantsan daga masu kamuwa da cuta", da "amfani da abin rufe fuska".
Northern Sotho: Maitshwaro a mabotse ao a lemogilwego a akareditše; “go tlogela sekgoba”, “diphetogo tša dijo tša phepommele”, “go hlapa diatla goba go sanithaesa”, “go itšhidulla”, “go phela ka tlhokomelo le batho bao ba nago le malwetši a go se alafege”, le “tšhomišo ya memaseke”.
Amharic: ተለይተው የወጡት ጤናማ ባህሪያት የሚከተሉትን ያካትታሉ፤ “ማህበራዊ ርቀትን መጠበቅ”፣ “አመጋገብን መቀየር”፣ “እጅ መታጠብ እና ሳኒታይዝ ማድረግ”፣ “የአካል ብቃት እንቅስቃሴ” “ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ባሏቸው ሰዎች ውስጥ የጨመረ ንቃት”፣ እና “የፊት ጭምብሎችን መጠቀም”፡፡

English: In another analysis, the impacts of COVID-19 related news on healthy behaviors were; “behavior modification”, “anxious impacts”, and “fake news about COVID-19 caused people to stop listening to COVID-19 related news”.
Luganda: Mu kwekenneenya okulala, ebireetebwa amawulire agakwata ku COVID-19 ku nneeyisa mu byobulamu byali; “okulongoosa mu nneeyisa”, “okweraliikirira”, era “amawulire amakyamu ku COVID-19 gaaleetera abantu okulekera awo okuwuliriza amawulire agakwata ku COVID-19”.
Yoruba: Nihnú ìtúpalẹ̀ mìíràn, àwọn ipa ìròyìn tí ó jẹmọ́ COVID-19 ni ''yíyí ìwà padà fẹ́ẹ́rẹ́fẹ́'', ''ipa ìmọ̀lára'', àti ''ìròyìn èké nípa COVID-19 jẹ́ kí àwọn ènìyàn dẹ́kun gbígbọ́ ìròyìn tó bá jẹmọ́ COVID-19''.
Zulu: Kokunye okuhlaziyiwe, umthelela wezindaba ezibika nge-COVID-19 ekuziphatheni kahle ngokwezempilo kube “ukushintsha indlela yokwenza”, “uvalo”, “izindaba ze-COVID-19 ezingamanga zidale ukuthi abantu bayeke ukulalela izindaba ezikhuluma nge-COVID-19”.
Hausa: A wani bincike, tasirin labarai masu alaƙa da COVID-19 akan halayen lafiya sune; "gyara halayya", "tasirin damuwa", da "labarai na karya game da COVID-19 sun sa mutane daina sauraron labarai masu alaka da COVID-19".
Northern Sotho: Go tshekatsheko ye nngwe, dikhuetšo ya ditaba tše di amanago le COVID-19 go maitshwaro a mabotse e bile; “phetogo ya maitshwaro”, “ditlamorago tša letšhogo”, le “ditaba tša bofora mabapi le COVID-19 tše di hlotšego batho gore ba se sa theeletša ditaba tše di amanago le COVID-19”.
Amharic: በሌላ ትንተና ከኮቪድ-19 ጤናማ  ባህሪያት ተጽእኖዎች ጋር የተያያዙ ዜናዎች የሚከተሉት ነበሩ፤ “የባህሪ ለውጥ”፣ “የሚያስጨንቁ ተጽእኖዎች”፣ እና “ስለ ኮቪድ-19 የሚነገሩ የውሸት ዜናዎች ሰዎች ስለ

English: Findings generated practical implications for enhancing healthy behaviors during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa byalaga ebirina okukolebwa okulongoosa enneeyisa mu byobulamu mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àbọ̀ ìwádìí ṣàkójọ àbájáde tí ó ṣeé múlò láti ṣèrànwọ́ ìwà ìmáralè lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Imiphumela ikhiphe izincazelo ezilula ezingagqugquzela ukuziphatha kahle ngesikhathi sempathamhlaba i-COVID-19.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken ya haifar da tasiri mai amfani don haɓaka ɗabi'un lafiya yayin bala'in COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo di tšweleditše ditharollo tše di ka phethagatšwag tša go kaonafatša maitshwaro a mabotse nakong ya leuba la COVID-19.
Amharic: ግኝቶቹ በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ ጤናማ ባህሪያትን ለማበረታታት የሚጠቅሙ ተግባራዊ አንድምታዎችን ፈጥረዋል፡፡

English: The role of the media in strengthening healthy behaviors during the pandemic was also highlighted.
Luganda: Omulimu gw’amawulire mu kunyweza enneeyisa mu byobulamu mu kiseera kya nawookeera nagwo gwayogerwako.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàfihàn ipa àwọn akọ̀ròyìn nínú ríró ìwà ìmahrale lágbára lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn.
Zulu: Kugqanyiswe indima yabezindaba ekuqiniseni ukuziphatha kahle ngokwezempilo ngesikhathi sempathamhlaba.

Northern Sotho: Tema ye e kgathwago ke bobegaditaba go matlafatšeng maitshwaro a mabotse nakong ya leuba le yona e ile ya gatelelwa.

English: During the Covid-19 pandemic, Nigerian people and the rest of the world had to make behavioural changes to stay safe.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa Covid-19, Abantu b’omu Nigerian n’awalala mu nsi baalina okukyusa mu nneeyisa okusigala nga balamu.
Yoruba: Lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19, àwọn ènìyàn Nàìjíríà àti gbogbo àwọn yòókù lágbàáyé nílò láti yíwà padà láti dáàbò bo ara wọn.
Zulu: Ngesikhathi sempathamhlaba i-Covid-19, abaseNayjeriya nabasemhlabeni wonke bekumele beshintshe indlela yokuziphatha ukuze baphephe.
Hausa: A lokacin barkewar cutar ta Covid-19, mutanen Najeriya da sauran kasashen duniya dole ne su yi canje-canjen hali don a zauna lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Nakong ya leuba la Covid-19, badudi ba Nigeria le ba lefase ka bophara ba ile ba swanelwa ke go fetoša maitshwaro gore ba dule ka polokego.
Amharic: በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ የናይጄሪያ ሰዎች እና የቀረው የአለም ህዝብ ደህነነትን ለመጠበቅ የባህሪ ለውጥ ማምጣት ነበረበት፡፡

English: Covid-19 related news shared by the media has had both positive and negative effects on the behavioural changes of people in Nigeria.
Luganda: Amawulire agakwata ku Covid-19 agafulumizibwa mu mikutu gy’amawulire galina ebirungi n’ebibi ku nkyukakyuka y’enneeyisa mu bantu b’omu Nigeria.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìròyìn tí wọ́n jẹmọ́ COVID-19 tí àwọn akọ̀ròyìn gbé jáde kó ipa rere àti búbúrú lórí ìyíwàpadà àwọn ènìyàn Nàìjíríà.
Zulu: Izindaba eziphathele ne-Covid-19 ezisakazwe abezindaba zibe nomthelela omuhle nomubi ekushintsheni kokuziphatha kwabantu eNayjeriya.
Hausa: Labaran da ke da alaqa da Covid-19 da kafafen yaxa labarai ke yaxawa sun yi tasiri mai kyau da mara kyau a kan sauye-sauyen halayen mutane a Najeriya.
Northern Sotho: Ditaba tše di amanago le Covid-19 tše di phatlalatšwago ke bobegaditaba di bile le ditlamorago tša go thabiša le tša go se thabiše go diphetogo tša maitshwaro go badudi ba Nigeria.
Amharic: በሚዲያ የተላለፉ እና ከኮቪድ-19 ጋር የተያያዙ ዜናዎች የናይጄሪያ ህዝቦች ባሳዩት የባህሪ ለውጥ ላይ አሉታዊም አውንታዊም ተጽእኖ ነበራቸው፡፡

English: To stay safe during the pandemic, we all needed to practice social distancing, hand washing and wearing of masks, as well as being aware of our general health.
Luganda: Okubeera abalamu mu kiseera kya nawookeera ono, ffenna twali twetaaga okwewa amabanga, okunaaba mu ngalo n’okwambala obukookolo, awamu n’okubeera nga tumanyi embeera y’obulamu bwaffe ey’awamu.
Yoruba: Láti wà nínú ààbò lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn náà, gbogbo lá ní láti ta kété síra, fọ ọwọ́, wọ ìbòmú, àti kí á ní ìwàláàyè wa lọ́kàn.
Zulu: Ukuze siphephe gesikhathi sempathamhlaba, bekudingeka ukuthi sonke siqhelelane, ukugezwa kwezandla nokugqokwa kwezamfonyo, nokunaka izimpilo zethu.
Hausa: Don kasancewa cikin aminci yayin bala'in, dukkanmu muna buƙatar aiwatar da nisantar da jama'a, wanke hannu da sanya abin rufe fuska, tare da sanin lafiyarmu gaba ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Gore re dule ka polokego nakong ya leuba, re swanelwa ke go itlwaetša go tlogela sekgoba, go hlapa diatla le go apara memaseke, gammogo le go ela tlhoko maphelo a rena ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: በወረርሽኙ ጊዜ ደህንነትን ለማስጠበቅ ሁላችንም ማህበራዊ ርቀትን መጠበቅ፣ እጃችንን መታጠብ እና የፊት ጭምብሎችን ማድረግ እና በአጠቃላይ ስለጤንነታችን ንቁ መሆንን መለማመድ ነበረብን፡፡

English: We are all dependent on the media to inform us of the ways we can prevent the virus from spreading.
Luganda: Ffenna twesigama ku mawulire okututegeeza engeri gye tuyinza okuziyizaamu akawuka okusaasaana.
Yoruba: Gbogbo wa ni a gbẹ́mìí lé àwọn akọ̀ròyìn láti fi àwọn ọ̀nà tí a lè gbà sénà mọ́ kòkòrò náà kí ó má tàn.
Zulu: Sonke sithembele kwabezindaba ukuthi basazise ngezindlela esingagwema ngazo ukubhebhetheka kwegciwane.
Hausa: Dukkanmu mun dogara ga kafafen yaxa labarai don sanar da mu hanyoyin da za mu iya hana yaxuwar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ka moka ga rena re botile bobegaditaba go re lemoša ka ditsela tšeo re ka thibelago baerase gore e se phatlalale.
Amharic: ሁላችንም ቫይረሱን ከመስፋፋት የምናስቆምበትን መንገዶች ለማወቅ ሚዲያ በሚሰጠን መረጃ ላይ ጥገኛ ነን፡፡

English: It is important to understand which behaviours were adopted by participants in Nigeria, and how the media played a positive and negative role during this time.
Luganda: Kikulu okutegeera enneeyisa ezaakoppebwa abeetabi mu Nayijeeriya, n’engeri emikutu gy’amawulira gye gyeyisaamu mu ngeri ennungi n’embi mu kiseera kino.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe pàtàkì lahti ní àgbọ́yé àwọn ìwà tí àwọn akópa láti Nàjíríà yàn, àti bí àwọn akọ̀ròyìn ṣe kó ipa rere àti búburú lásìkò yìí.
Zulu: Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iziphi izindlela zokuziphatha ezathathwa abahlanganyeli eNayjeriya, nokuthi abezindaba bayidlale kanjani indima enhle noma embi ngalesi sikhathi.
Hausa: Yana da kyau a fahimci irin halayen da mahalarta taron suka yi a Najeriya, da yadda kafafen yada labarai suka taka rawa mai kyau da mara kyau a wannan lokacin.
Northern Sotho: Go bohlokwa go kwešiša gore ke maitshwaro afe ao a bego a šomišwa ke bakgathatema go la Nigeria, le ka moo bobegaditaba bo kgathilego tema ye e thabišago goba ye e sa thabišego nakong ye.
Amharic: በናይጄሪያ ባሉ ተሳታፊዎች የትኞቹ ባህሪያት እንደተተገበሩ መረዳት እና ሚዲያ አንዴት አሉታዊም አውንታዊም ተጽእኖ እንዳደረሰ ማወቅ አስፈላጊ ነው፡፡

English: This study surveyed the good behavioural changes adopted by Nigerian participants during the Covid-19 pandemic.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwekaliriza enkyukakyuka ennungi mu nneeyisa z’abeetabi mu Nigeria mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa Covid-19.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí fimú fínlẹ̀ àwọn ìyípadà ìwà rere tí àwọn akópa Nàìjíríà yàn lásìkò àjàkahlẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlolisise inguquko enhle yokuziphatha ekhethwe abahlangnyeli baseNayjeriya ngesikhathi se-Covid-19.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi nazari kan kyawawan sauye-sauyen ɗabi'a da mahalarta Najeriya suka ɗauka yayin bala'in Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di dirile diphatišišo ka diphetogo tše botse tša maitshwaro tše di latetšwego ke bakgathatema ba naga ya Nigeria nakong ya leuba la Covid-19.
Amharic: ይሄ ጥናት በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ በናይጄሪያዊ ተሳታፊዎች የተተገበሩ የባህሪ ለውጦችን ዳስሷል፡፡

English: It also looked at how participants were otherwise affected by the media during the pandemic.
Luganda: Era kwatunuulira engeri abeetabi gye baakosebwamu emikutu gy’amawulire mu kiseera kya nawookeera ono.
Yoruba: Ó tún wo bí ó ṣe ní ipa àwọn akọ̀ròyìn kó lórí àwọn akópa lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn náà.
Zulu: Lubheke nokuthi abezindaba babe namthelela muni kubahlanganyeli ngesikhathi sempathamhlaba.
Hausa: An kuma duba yadda qafafen yaxa labarai suka shafi mahalarta taron yayin bala'in.
Northern Sotho: Di lebeletše le ka moo bakgathatema ba amilwego ke bobegaditaba ka gona nakong ya leuba.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በወረርሽኙ ጊዜ ተሳታፊዎች በሚዲያ በሌላ መንገድ  እንዴት ተጽእኖ እንደደረሰባቸው ዳስሷል፡፡

English: The researcher created an online questionnaire that was distributed using social media.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza yateekateeka ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano ebyaweebwa abeetabi okuyita ku mikutu emigattabantu.
Yoruba: Aṣèwádìí ṣẹ̀dá àtòjọ-ìbéèrè lórí ẹ̀rọ alátagbà tí wọ́n sì pín lórí ẹ̀ro-alátagbà.
Zulu: Umcwaningi wakhe uhlu lwemibuzo ku-inthanethi, olusabalaliswe ngezinkundla zokuxhumana.
Hausa: Mai binciken ya ƙirƙiri takardar tambayoyin kan layi wanda aka rarraba ta amfani da kafofin watsa labarun.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o hlamile lenaneopotšišo la dinyakišišo la inthaneteng leo le phatlaladitšwego ka tšhomišo ya dikgokaganyo tša leago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪው ማህበራዊ ሚዲያን በመጠቀም የተሰራጨ የመስመር ላይ መጠይቅ ሰርቶ ነበር፡፡

English: Participants had to give information about their demographics (like their age and gender), their own behaviours to stay healthy and avoid Covid-19, and how they were affected by news about Covid-19.
Luganda: Abeetabi baawaayo obubaka obukwata ku bibakwatako (nga emyaka n’ekikula), enneeyisa zaabwe ezibayamba okubeera abalamu n’okwewala Covid-19, n’engeri gye baakosebwamu amawulire agakwata ku Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn akópa ni láti sọ nípa arawọn (bíi ọjọ́-orí àti ìṣakọṣabo), àwọn ìwà wọn láti márale àti láti yẹra fún Covid-19, àti ipa ìròyìn tí ó jẹmọ́ Covid-19 kó lórí wọn.
Zulu: Abahlanganyeli bekumele bakiphe imininingwane yabo (njengeminyaka nobulili), indlela yabo yokuziphatha ukuze behlale bephilile futhi bagweme i-Covid-19, nokuthi izindaba ze-Covid-19 zibathinte kanjani.
Hausa: Dole ne mahalarta su ba da bayanai game da alƙaluman su (kamar shekarunsu da jinsi), halayensu don kasancewa cikin koshin lafiya da guje wa Covid-19, da yadda labarai game da Covid-19 suka shafe su.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba be ba swanelwa go fana ka tshedimošo mabapi le dipalopalo tša bona (tše bjalo ka mengwaga ya bona le bong), maitshwaro a bona a go phela gabotse le go efoga Covid-19, le ka moo ba amilwego ka gona ke ditaba tša mabapi le Covid-19.
Amharic: ተሳታፊዎቹ ህዝበ ነክ መረጃዎቻቸውን እንደ (እድሜ እና ጾታ)፣እና ለራሳቸው በጤና ለመቆየት ስለተገበሯቸው ባህሪያት እና ስለ ኮቪድ-19 በሚቀርቡ ዜናዎች እንዴት እንደተጎዱ መረጃ መስጠት ነበረባቸው፡፡

English: The 33 participants (17 females and 16 males) reported behaviours like social distancing, mask wearing and hand washing to avoid being infected with or spreading Covid-19.
Luganda: Abeetabi 33 (abakazi 17 n’abasajja 16) baalaga enneeyisa nga okwewa amabanga, okwambala obukookolo n’okunaaba mu ngalo okwewala okukwatibwa n’okusaasaanya Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn akópa 33 (abo 17 àti akọ 16) jábọ̀ àwọn ìwà bí ìtakété síra ẹni, wíwọ ìbòmú, àti ọwọ́ fífọ̀ lahti yẹra fún kíkó àti títàn Covid-19.
Zulu: Abahlanganyeli abawu-33 (17 wabesifazane no-16 wabesilisa) babike ukuziphatha okufana nokuqhelelana, ukugqoka izamfonyo nokugeza izandla ukuze bagweme ukutheleleka noma ukubhebhethekisa i-Covid-19.
Hausa: Mahalarta taron 33 (mata 17 da maza 16) sun ba da rahoton halaye kamar nisantar da jama'a, sanya abin rufe fuska da wanke hannu don gujewa kamuwa da cutar ko yada Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba 33 (basadi ba 17 le banna ba 16) ba begile maitshwaro a bjalo ka go tlogela sekgoba, go apara memaseke le go hlapa diatla go efoga go fetelwa ke goba go phatlalatša Covid-19.
Amharic: 33ቱ ተሳታፊዎች (17 ሴት እና 16 ወንድ) ኮቪድ-19ን ከማስፋፋት እና በበሽታው ከመበከል ለመቆጠብ እንደ ማህበራዊ ርቀትን መጠበቅ፣ የፊት ጭምብሎችን ማድረግ እና እጅን መታጠብ አይነት ባህሪያትን እንደተገበሩ ዘግበዋል፡፡

English: Most of the participants said that these behaviours were inspired by Covid-19-related news, but that the news also increased their anxiety.
Luganda: Abeetabi abasinga baagamba nti enneeyisa zino zaava ku mawulire agakwata ku Covid-19, naye nti era amawulire gaayongera ku kweraliikirira kwabwe.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn akópa náà àwọn ìròyìn tí wọ́n jẹmọ́ COVID-19 ní wọ́n bí àwon ìwà wọ̀nyí, àmọ́ àwọn ìròyìn náà túnbọ̀ ṣàfikún ìmọ̀lára wọn.
Zulu: Abahlanganyeli abaningi bathe lezi zindlela zokuziphatha zigqugquzelwe izindaba eziphathelene ne-Covid-19, kodwa lezi zindaba zibanyusele uvalo.
Hausa: Yawancin mahalarta taron sun ce waɗannan halayen sun samo asali ne daga labarai masu alaƙa da Covid-19, amma labarin ya kuma ƙara musu damuwa.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja bakgathatema ba boletše gore maitshwaro a a hlohleleditšwe ke ditaba tše di amanago le Covid-19, le gore ditaba le tšona di okeditše letšhogo la bona.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ ተሳታፊዎች እነዚህ ባህሪዎች የመነጩት ከኮቪድ-19 ጋር በተያያዙ ዜናዎች ምክንያት እንደሆነ የገለጹ ሲሆን ነገር ግን ዜናዎቹ ጭንቀትንም እንዳባባሱ ጠቁመዋል፡፡

English: Some even avoided Covid-19 news because of the rise in fake news.
Luganda: Abamu baatuuka n’okwewala amawulire agakwata ku Covid-19 olw’okweyongera kw’amawulire amakyamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn kan tilẹ̀ yàgò fún ìròyìn COVID-19 torí àwọn ewu tí ó wà nínú ayédèrú ìròyìn.
Zulu: Abenye baze bazigwema izindaba ze-Covid-19 ngenxa yokwanda kwezindaba ezingamanga.
Hausa: Wasu ma sun guji labaran Covid-19 saboda qaruwar labaran karya.
Northern Sotho: Ba bangwe ba be ba tšhabana le ditaba tša Covid-19 ka lebaka la tlhatlogo ya ditaba tša bofora.
Amharic: በውሸት ዜና ምክንያት አንዳንዶች እንዲያውም ከነጭራሹ የኮቪድ-19 ዜናዎችን መስማት አቁመው ነበር፡፡

English: Many studies focused on behavioural changes relating to mental health during the Covid-19 pandemic, but this study looked specifically at the role the media plays in such behaviour change.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kungi kwatunuulira enkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa ezikwata ku mbeera z’emitwe mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa Covid-19, naye okunoonyereza kuno kwatunuulira omulimu gw’emikutu gy’amawulire mu nkyukakyuka ezo.
Yoruba: Ọpọ̀ ìwádìí fi àyípadà nínú ìwà tí ó níiṣe pẹ̀lú ìṣọwọ́ronú lásìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19 ṣe àfojúsùn wọn, àmọ́ ìwádìí yìí wo ipa tí àwọn akọ̀ròyìn kó nínú orú àyípadà ìwà bẹ́ẹ̀ ní pàtó.
Zulu: Ucwaningo olunigi lugxile ekushintsheni kokuziphatha okumayelana nempilo yomqondo ngesikhathisempathamhlaa i-Covid-19, kodwa lolu cwaningo lubheke indima edlalwa abezindaba ekushintsheni kokuziphatha.
Hausa: Yawancin bincike sun mayar da hankali kan sauye-sauyen ɗabi'a da suka shafi lafiyar hankali yayin bala'in Covid-19, amma wannan binciken ya yi duba na musamman kan rawar da qafofin watsa labarai ke takawa a irin wannan canjin ɗabi'a.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše dintši di be di nepile go diphetogo tša maitshwaro tše di amanago le go phelega gabotse monaganong nakong ya leuba la Covid-19, eupša dinyakišišo tše di be di lebeletše kudu go tema ye e kgathwago ke bobegaditaba go phetogo yeo ya maitshwaro.
Amharic: ብዙዎቹ ጥናቶች ያተኮሩት በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ጊዜ በተከሰቱ ከስነልቦናዊ ጤና ጋር የተያያዙ የባህሪ ለውጦች ላይ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ይህ ጥናት በተለይ እነዚህን የባህሪ ለውጦችን ለማምጣት ሚዲያ የተጫወተው ሚና ላይ አተኩሮ ነበር፡፡

English: This study also looked at the role the media plays in encouraging healthy behaviour changes that keep people safe.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno era kwatunuulira omulimu gw’emikutu gy’amawulire mu kukubiriza abantu okukyusa mu nneeyisa mu byobulamu basobole okubeera abalamu.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà tún wo ipa tí àwọn akọròyìn ń kó nínú ṣíṣe ìwúrí fún ìwà ìmárale tí ó ń dáàbò bo àwọn ènìyàn lásìkò ewu.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lubuye lwabheka indima edlalwa abezindaba ukugqugquzela ukushintsha kokuziphatha kahle okugcina abantu bephephile.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya kuma duba rawar da qafofin watsa labarai ke takawa wajen ƙarfafa sauye-sauyen ɗabi'a da ke kiyaye lafiyar mutane.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di ile tša lebelela le tema yeo e kgathwago ke bobegaditaba go hlohleletšeng diphetogo tša maitshwaro a mabotse ao a thušago batho gore ba phele ka polokego.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በተጨማሪም ጤናማ የባህሪ ለውጦችን ለማበረታታት እና የሰዎችን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ ሚዲያ የሚጫወተውን ሚና ዳስሷል፡፡

English: The researcher notes that the study excluded participants without access to the internet, and states that this limitation, along with the selection of the questions, could have compromised their findings.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza alaga nti okunoonyereza kwaleka ebbali abeetabi abatafuna yintaneeti, era agamba nti omuziziko guno, awamu n’ennonda y’ebibuuzo, biyinza okuba nga byakosa ebyazuulibwa.
Yoruba: Àṣèwádìí tún pe àkíyèsí si pé ìwádìí náà yọ àwọn tí wọn kò ní àǹfànàní láti lo ẹ̀rọ-alátagbà sílẹ̀, ó sì fi yéni pé ìdiwọ̀n yìí, àti ṣíṣe àsàyàn àwọn ìbéẹ̀rè, le tì dènà ìjágeere àwọn àbọ̀ wọn.
Zulu: Umcwaningi ubika ukuthi lolu cwaningo alubafakanga abahlanganyeli abangenayo i-inthanethi, aphinde abike ukuthi lengqinamba, kanye nokukhethwa kwemibuzo, kungezeka kuyekethise imiphumela yabo.
Hausa: Mai binciken ya lura cewa binciken ya cire mahalarta ba tare da yin amfani da intanet ba, kuma ya bayyana cewa wannan iyakancewa, tare da zaɓin tambayoyin, zai iya yin illa ga binciken su.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o lemoga gore dinyakišišo di be di sa akaretše bakgathatema bao ba se nago inthanete, le go laetša gore tšhitišo ye, gammogo le kgetho ya dipotšišo, di ka ba di šitišitše dikutollo tša bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪው እንዳሳሰበው ይህ ጥናት ኢንተርኔት ማግኘት የማይችሉ ተሳታፊዎችን አላካተተም፤ እናም ይህ ገደብ ከጥያቄ አመራረጥ ጋር አንድ ላይ በመሆን የግኝታቸውን ተአማኒነት አጠራጣሪ ሊያደርገው እንደሚችል ገልጿል፡፡

English: The researcher also notes that because the anxiety levels of the participants were self-reported, there was no way to truly quantify participant anxiety levels due to news about Covid-19.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza era alaga nti olw’okuba ng’abeetabi be beetegeereza obweraliikirivu bwabwe, tewaaliwo ngeri ya kupima mu butuufu obweraliikirivu bw’abeetabi olw’amawulire agakwata ku Covid-19.
Yoruba: Aṣèwádìí náà tún ṣàkíyèsí pé torí àwọn akópa ni wọ́n jábọ̀ ìmọ̀lára wọn fúnra wọn, kò sí bí wọ́n ṣe lè mọ òótọ́ ìmọ̀lára wọn nípa àwọn ìròyìn tí wọ́n jẹmọ́ COVID-19.
Zulu: Umcwaningi uphinde abike ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi amazinga ovalo lwabahlaganyeli bebezibikele bona, ibingekho indlela yokugagula uvalo lwabahlanganyeli ngenxa yezindaba nge-Covid-19.
Hausa: Mai binciken ya kuma lura cewa saboda matakan damuwa na mahalarta an ba da rahoton kansu, babu wata hanyar da za a iya ƙididdige matakan damuwa na mahalarta saboda labarai game da Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o lemoga le gore ka lebaka la dikelo tša letšhogo tša bakgathatema di be di itlhaloša, go be go se na tsela yeo go ka tlogago go elwa bogolo bja letšhogo la bakgathatema ka lebaka la ditaba tša mabapi le Covid-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪው በተጨማሪ እንዳሳሰበው ተሳታፊዎቹ የጭንቀት ደረጃቸውን በራሳቸው ሪፖርት ስላደረጉ በኮቪድ -19 ዜና ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን የተሳታፊዎች የጭንቀት ደረጃ  በእርግጥ መመጠን የሚቻልበት ምንም መንገድ የለም፡፡

English: The researcher noted that the media could encourage and strengthen healthy behaviours if they do not spread Covid-19 related fear.
Luganda: Omunoonyereza yalaga nti emikutu gy’amawulire gisobola okukubiriza abantu n’okunyweza enneeyisa mu byobulamu singa baba tebasaasaanyizza kutya okukwata ku Covid-19.
Yoruba: Aṣèwádìí náà tún fi yéni pé àwọn akọ̀ròyìn tún lè ṣe ìwurí fún, àti kí wọ́n jẹ́ kí ìwà ìmárale wu àwọn ènìyàn bí wọn kò bá tan àwọn ẹ̀rù tí wọ́n jẹmọ́ COVID-19 ká.

Northern Sotho: Monyakišiši o lemogile gore bobegaditaba bo ka hlohleletša le go matlafatša maitshwaro a mabotse ge bo sa phatlalatše letšhogo le le amanago le Covid-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪው እንዳሳሰበው ሚዲያ ከኮቪድ-19 ጋር የተያያዘ ፍርሃትን እስካላሰራጨ ድረስ ጤናማ ባህሪያትን ሊያበረታታ እና ሊያጠናክር ይችላል፡፡

English: The researcher was based in Nigeria and the participants of this study were all from Nigeria.
